hooks.command:
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty')
[ -z "$f" ] && exit 0
map=".claude/docs-map.json"
[ -f "$map" ] || exit 0
entries_file=$(mktemp)
jq -c '.[]' "$map" > "$entries_file"
matches="[]"
while IFS= read -r entry; do
  title=$(printf '%s' "$entry" | jq -r '.title')
  doc=$(printf '%s' "$entry" | jq -r '.doc')
  hit=0
  paths_file=$(mktemp)
  printf '%s' "$entry" | jq -r '.paths[]' > "$paths_file"
  while IFS= read -r pattern; do
    case "$f" in $pattern) hit=1 ;; esac
  done < "$paths_file"
  rm -f "$paths_file"
  if [ "$hit" = 1 ]; then
    matches=$(jq -cn --argjson m "$matches" --arg t "$title" --arg d "$doc" '$m + [{title:$t, doc:$d}]')
  fi
done < "$entries_file"
rm -f "$entries_file"
[ "$matches" = "[]" ] && exit 0
jq -n --argjson m "$matches" '
  ("Docs that may now be outdated: " + ([$m[] | (.title + " (" + .doc + ")")] | join("; ")) + ". Use the documentation skill to review/update.") as $msg
  | {systemMessage: $msg, hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: $msg}}'
